newsitem.title: USA: American Exchange net up 46 pct, oper at $9.6 mln.
newsitem.headline: American Exchange net up 46 pct, oper at $9.6 mln.

text.p: The American Stock Exchange on Thursday said that its net operating income before restructuring costs was $9.6 million for the nine-month period, and that net income after restructuring costs was $6.8 million, 46 percent higher than the year-ago period.
The Exchange reported 20 new listings in each of the second and third quarters and said it expects to reach 70 companies by year-end.
It said it expects to continue the momentum through the final quarter and improve in 1997.

The Exchange also said there were $69.3 billion shares traded, close to the yearly record of $72.7 billion in 1995, and that options trading averaged 231,000 contracts a day, up 14 percent over the period last year.
